output_payload.state_specific_notes: Art 143(3) MiCA Reg. (EU) 2023/1114: providers lawfully serving before 30 December 2024 may continue until 1 July 2026 or until their Article 63 authorisation is granted or refused, whichever is sooner. Member States may disapply or shorten the regime (Art 143(3) second subparagraph); the ESMA grandfathering list records national expectations, some of which may not yet be in national law.
